purpose: Determine whether the existing fixed out-of-fold incremental width predictions translate into better selected candidate continuation values than the identically fitted base correction
post_hoc_status: Definitions frozen before this decision-utility calculation, after prior analyses of these development outcomes and predictive summaries. This is exploratory internal reuse, not new confirmation.
prediction_provenance: Use only saved cv.episodes predictions from the exact pinned grouped diagnostic. Validate128 unique group IDs and metadata,8 balanced folds,112 training and16 held-out episodes per fold, all actions grouped, and each scoring episode absent from its fit's training IDs. Verify corresponding pinned source/freeze and unchanged input identities. No refitting or new inference.

score_mapping.corrected_base: Q1 minus saved held-out base prediction of within-state-centered signed Q1-V error
score_mapping.corrected_width: Q1 minus saved held-out base-plus-residual-width prediction of within-state-centered signed Q1-V error
score_mapping.bca_kappa_3: Q1 minus3 times frozen raw U
score_mapping.contrast_actor_distance_kappa_0.1: Q1 minus0.1 times19.29619572569095 times actor squared-distance

mapping_justification: Coefficient one follows the prediction target's original Q/return units. With an exact centered error prediction, Q1-(Q1-V-mean(Q1-V)) equals V plus a state-constant. No coefficient search, clipping, recentering, sign restriction, refit or outcome-dependent mapping is performed.
method_identity: The two corrected scores are signed-error correction diagnostics, not original BCA, calibrated uncertainty bounds, conservative lower confidence bounds, or approved production methods. Their regressions used other development episodes' simulator-return labels. Original BCA/distance controls did not receive those labels; their comparisons here are descriptive, not a fair claim of deployable algorithm superiority.
target: Saved deterministic simulator value for candidate action first then same frozen current actor, gamma .98, remaining finite horizon100 and no terminal bootstrap. Evaluate selected candidates with this value only after all score selections are fixed.
target_caveats: There is no conditional Monte Carlo return sampling noise in these authenticated deterministic continuations. They are numerical values, not certified exact real arithmetic. Q1's smoothed lagged-policy TD target may differ from current frozen-actor V. U remains a twin-min one-step residual proxy, not a Q1-error coverage guarantee.
selection_rule: Compute all scores without values. Select the first bank index satisfying abs(score-maximum_score)<=1e-6+1e-6*abs(maximum_score); preserve original bank order and report complete near-max set. Do not use returns to break score ties.
ambiguity_rule: Report score-ambiguity counts and selections per method; retain all episodes in primary and secondary summaries. Ambiguity is descriptive, not a post-hoc exclusion or outcome gate.
primary_comparison: corrected_width minus corrected_base selected continuation value
primary_metric: Equal-episode mean paired selected-value gain across all128 starting episodes, in discounted-return units. Each episode and all its candidates remain grouped.
candidate_regret: Exact maximum saved candidate value minus selected candidate value; this is finite-bank regret, not global regret or policy-learning improvement.
event_definition: Different selected candidate indices define a decision-disagreement event, regardless of value difference. Report prevalence, conditional mean gain on those events and unconditional mean gain; verify unconditional equals prevalence times conditional. If none differ, conditional gain is undefined and unconditional zero.
return_direction_rule: Among differing decisions, win/loss/near_equal uses abs(value_width-value_base)<=1e-6+1e-6*max(abs(value_width),abs(value_base)) as the near-equal band. All actual paired gains, including near-equal ones, remain in the primary mean.
bootstrap_definition: Primary only, np.random.default_rng(seed), independently sample16 paired episode gains with replacement in each of8 batch/time cells, mean all128 equally, percentile2.5/97.5 with np.quantile(method=linear). No action-level resampling and no additional secondary confidence intervals.
bootstrap_scope: Exploratory nominal95% interval conditional on the already saved out-of-fold predictions, folds and fitted models. Does not include model-refitting dependence, prior analytic selection or training-seed variation; not an efficacy or generalization guarantee.
secondary_summaries: For all five fixed methods report mean selected value and mean candidate-bank regret. Report corrected_width minus each other method descriptively, with no extra intervals, winner choice or coefficient selection. Report primary by batch, time and all8cells. Full per-episode scores, selections, near-max sets and gains are retained.
cross_batch_check: Apply identical fixed mappings to each saved transfer direction,64 episodes each; verify target episode IDs absent from that transfer fit's training IDs and metadata align. Report descriptive primary gain, decomposition, five methods and batch identity separately. These are previously examined development data, not independent confirmation.
decision_rule: Report direction/magnitude, conditional interval, frequency of changed decisions, batch/transfer stability and limitations without approving a production method. Predictive gain alone is not decision utility. A positive diagnostic result does not overturn the prior inconclusive confirmation or the earlier failed signed propagated-error candidate.
